nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) implemented in GPy (Python).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to model the development of absolute and relative tissue volumes in the control sample from 32 to 46 weeks PMA at scan. GPR modeling was implemented using GPy in Python
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: FukamiGartner2023.pdf.md: Normative modeling using Gaussian process regression

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Absolute and relative regional tissue volumes from neonatal T2-weighted MRI, including cortical GM, WM, deep GM, cerebellum, lateral ventricles, eCSF, and whole brain volumes.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to model the development of absolute and relative tissue volumes in the control sample from 32 to 46 weeks PMA at scan. T2-weighted images were segmented into seven main tissue/fluid classes: extra-cerebral cerebrospinal fluid (eCSF), lateral ventricles, cortical GM, WM, deep GM, cerebellum, and brainstem
nm2_2_response_variable.location: FukamiGartner2023.pdf.md: Normative modeling using Gaussian process regression; MR image segmentation
